full_query: If this is just muscle strain, how many days should I expect the pain to go away?

shared_context.topic: duration of pain relief for muscle strain

sentences: Muscle strain, also known as pulled muscle, typically causes pain that can resolve within a few days to several weeks, depending on the severity of the strain
Mild muscle strains: Pain usually improves within a few days to a week
Moderate muscle strains: Pain may last for several weeks, often 2 to 3 weeks
Severe muscle strains: Pain and dysfunction can last for several months and may require rehabilitation
General healing process: The healing time for muscle strains can vary based on the individual's overall health, the specific muscle involved, and adherence to recommended treatment protocols
Common treatment: Rest, ice, compression, and elevation (RICE) and over-the-counter pain medications are commonly used to manage muscle strain symptoms
